bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 创 52 周新低，跌破 $270

read.en: Alphabet fell 2.7% on Nov 20 to $265.29, its lowest close since Oct 24, 2025, trading $264.22–283.14, a new 52-week low, on above-average volume (1.32x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($276.9), 10-day ($284.8), 30-day ($306.6), 100-day ($334.7) and 200-day ($337.0), all falling. MACD crossed back below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($302.66), and RSI is 27.8, oversold.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月20日下跌 2.7%，收于 $265.29，为 2025年10月24日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $264.22–283.14，创 52 周新低，成交量高于均值（为 20 日均量的 1.32 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$276.9）、10 日（$284.8）、30 日（$306.6）、100 日（$334.7）和 200 日均线（$337.0）下方，均在下行。MACD 于 11月20日重新下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$302.66），RSI 为 27.8，处于超卖区。

read.en: The close broke both written supports, $270–273.5 (Mar 30 low, Nov 14, 2025 low), now resistance, after an intraday reversal from $283.14. Resistance is $270.7–272.7, then $276.9–278.5 (5-day, Oct 30 and Nov 5 lows) and $283–284.8 (10-day). Support is $259.9–264.2 (Nov 20 low, Oct 24, 2025 close), then $256–257.3 and $251.3 (2025 highs). A close above $272.7 would target $277–278.5; below $259.9, $256–257.

r.en: Nov 14, 2025 low $270.70; Mar 30 low $272.11, lost; Nov 19 close $272.66
